judgment.rationale: The proposed diffusion model framework for hallucination suppression offers a novel approach to reducing erroneous outputs while preserving generative quality and efficiency. While the idea is not entirely new, the specific combination of uncertainty-aware factuality priors, plausibility scoring, and corrective bias fields is an innovative solution to the hallucination challenge. The soundness of the proposed method is high, as it is well-motivated, mathematically sound, and computationally efficient. The reproducibility of the work is also excellent, as the authors provide a clear experimental design, open-source code, and detailed documentation. The significance of the research is high, as it has the potential to impact various domains where factual accuracy and reliability are crucial.
